summary: This file is an ASP page primarily responsible for initiating the login screen of a web application. It declares the scripting language (VBScript), disables session state, sets up page buffering and cache prevention, and identifies the screen as 'Login'. It then includes another ASP file responsible for rendering or processing the screen.
purpose: To prepare and handle the login screen for a web application, likely as the entry point for user authentication.

fields.name: strScreenName
fields.description: Identifies the current screen context, set to 'Login'.

workflows.name: Login Screen Initialization
steps: Set response expiration to prevent caching.
Include and execute '/HSPnet/DoScreen.asp' which handles screen logic and rendering.

business_rules: Session state must be disabled for this screen.
Page content must not be cached.
validations: Ensure the screen name is correctly set to 'Login'.
conditions: Condition: Response buffering and cache prevention always enabled.
system_behavior: Loads login screen logic from shared ASP script.
Prevents caching of the login page for security.
dependencies: Depends on '/HSPnet/DoScreen.asp' for actual screen logic and rendering.
exceptions: If '/HSPnet/DoScreen.asp' is missing or fails, the login screen will not render.
content_gaps: The actual login process, user authentication logic, and field definitions are not present. These may be handled in the included DoScreen.asp file, which is not analyzed here.
